verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical. Both float the TRY NOW starburst in the upper middle without lining it up with the headline's left edge, both set the headline close to the left edge, and both shrink the figure to a small cluster on the right. A breaks the headline into the natural two lines, 'COUNT MEMORIES, / NOT PRICES.', so the parallel phrasing reads cleanly, but its right end crowds the figure's bag. B's three-line break, 'COUNT / MEMORIES, NOT / PRICES.', splits the 'memories, not prices' contrast and strands 'PRICES.' on its own line.
